title: California Campus, Commencement Procession - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot stamped 'MAR • 66' on the top margin, depicting a commencement or academic ceremony procession on a university campus. Two figures in doctoral or academic regalia (mortarboards and robes with hoods) walk along an outdoor paved courtyard, flanked by an assembled crowd of well-dressed students, faculty, and family members in 1960s suits and dresses. Modernist multi-story buildings and campus foliage provide a sunny mid-century institutional backdrop.
